'''Tim Schartz''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Bespin Regionals]] on 29 July 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Ops]], according to Nick Reisch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1073">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-01-omaha-nebraska-7-29-00d1073/ omaha-nebraska-7-29-00], DeckTech (Nick "aeneas23" Reisch, 1 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-01-omaha-nebraska-7-29-00d1073/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
